NVDA.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigned over a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy; SEC now probing Nvidia's disclosures
NVDA.summary: Huang resigned on Nov 12 after a board investigation into his relationship with an executive suspected of spying for China; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the board has ruled out reinstating him. The WSJ reported on Nov 17 that the SEC opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, and California's attorney general has subpoenaed the company over whether chips or confidential information reached China and whether investors were misled. The DOJ is also examining chip exports via Singapore, and Huang is due before three House committees on Dec 1.
